visual.general_description: Photograph of two plain abdominal radiograph films of an infant, shown side by side.
visual.detailed_description: Two photographed radiograph films shown side by side on a dark background. The left film shows a small infant torso and pelvis with ribs, spine and pelvic bones visible, a white 'R' marker near its upper left, a rounded distended-looking abdominal outline with gas-containing loops in the lower abdomen, and a measurement ruler along its lower edge. The right film is oriented differently, appears to show the infant from the side with a rounded abdominal contour and a darker rounded area in the mid abdomen, has a white 'L' marker near its upper right, and carries a printed label 'EXP:' followed by a date at its lower edge (what EXP abbreviates is not stated). A partially cropped line of printed text is visible at the bottom edge below the left film and cannot be read. Both films are photographed rather than exported images, so image quality is limited.

visual.general_description: Operative photograph of an open abdomen with retractors, dark red-brown organ surfaces, bright red tissue and pink bowel loops.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph of an open abdominal operative field. Green surgical drapes fill the top edge and yellow-tan abdominal wall tissue forms the margins at left, top and right. Two metal instruments, a retractor blade at the top and long forceps or retractors crossing diagonally from the lower left, hold the wound open. In the middle and upper part of the field are smooth dark red-brown organ surfaces, and at the upper right an area of bright red moist tissue with a rough surface. The lower half is filled with pale pink-tan loops of bowel with a glistening surface. No text, arrows, labels or scale are visible.
